decisions.reason: The revised spout-cleaning method does not change the bowl's capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraints.
Removability or flush-cleanability of the spout does not alter the existing leak-prevention and liquid-containment requirements; the same message's separate bowl-seal change is already represented.
The spout-cleaning method does not change the required smooth, controlled flow profile or flow-rate constraints; the same message's separate flow-rate change is already represented.
The cleaning-method revision does not necessarily change the valve's open/close or closed-state anti-drip behavior.
Making the spout removable or easy to flush does not necessarily change its bottom location, barista-facing orientation, or easy-pouring goal.
